record.chaining: a Russian KVM box with a dedicated IPv4 at USD 3.22, which is inside the under-USD-5 band but has no advantage over the wider machines there; recorded because its RUB 75 rung is the closest thing the Russian market has to a monthly sub-dollar machine

limits.value: 5 GB of SSD on this rung

record.binding_note: 5 GB of disk and 768 MB of RAM bind long before 3 TB of traffic does; this is a box for one small service, not a working machine.

identity_cost.detail: an account on the vendor's BILLmanager is required to order; the payment methods and any card hold were not read, so the card tier is inferred from a Russian hoster's usual checkout and is unverified. The site publishes a 24-hour test access before payment.

record.reliability_note: the cheapest rung is marked sold out today, which is the ordinary state of a loss-leader rung at a Russian hoster; the vendor has traded since 2015 per its own copy
record.confidence_note: the plan table, the prices and the stock state were read from the vendor's own page; the RUB conversion uses the Central Bank of Russia table for 2026-10-24

evidence.proved: quoted table rows: 'MSK-KVM-SSD-START1 | 1vCPU | 768 | 7 | 100 Mb/s 3 Tb/month | 75 RUB | Sold out' and 'EU-KVM-SSD-START-FIN1 | 1vCPU | 768 | 5 | 100 Mb/s 3 Tb/month | 259 RUB | order'
quoted page heading: 'Cheap VPS VDS server from 75 RUB/month, rent an inexpensive dedicated server in Moscow'; the price column is headed 'Price, RUB/month'
quoted rate table dated 24.10.2026: USD Nominal 1 Value 80,5381, so RUB 259 = USD 3.2159 and RUB 75 = USD 0.9312

record.notes: The advertised floor is RUB 75 a month (USD 0.9312) for a 1 vCPU / 768 MB / 7 GB KVM box in Moscow, and that rung is marked sold out today, so it is a price that exists and cannot be bought. The record prices the buyable rung instead, RUB 259 = USD 3.2159, which is the same shape with 5 GB of disk in Finland. Whether the RUB 75 rung returns, and how often, is not published. The plan table does not name an address count; the page copy says the machines come with dedicated IPs, which is not the same as a count on this rung. Payment rails and any card hold were not read.

extras.price_arithmetic: RUB 259 a month billed monthly at the CBR rate for 2026-10-24 of 80.5381 RUB per USD = USD 3.2159. The sold-out rung is RUB 75 = USD 0.9312. A VPS bills whether it runs or not, so the 24/7 and 10 h/day figures are the same.

session_cap.note: none; it is a KVM virtual machine

extras.renewal_note: the page prints one price per rung and no strike-through; no promo end date is published
